locator: Volume II, Table 3, printed pp. 110–111, Alaska
definition: Age and sex in the single Alaska census row. Unknown ages retain reported sex. The nominal national census date represents fieldwork from July 1899 through October 1900.
uncertainty: The Alaska age shares come from local census counts. The spread of field dates, the January 1900 conversion and the reasons for unreported ages have no quantified uncertainty.

locator: Volume II, Table 3, printed pp. 110–111, Hawaii
definition: Age and sex in the single Hawaii census row. Unknown ages retain reported sex.
uncertainty: The Hawaii age shares come from local census counts. Changes between January and June 1900 and the reasons for unreported ages have no quantified uncertainty.
